name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Three

releases.name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Three

description.text:
Play! Pokémon Prize Packs are six-card packs that Pokémon sends to Play! Pokémon stores to hand out at in-store events such as Leagues, League Challenges and League Cups; stores with more active events get more packs. Every card is a reprint that keeps its original set number and is marked with the Play! Pokémon logo.

Series Three, released on 14 August 2023, holds 163 cards from Brilliant Stars through Scarlet & Violet, plus Scarlet & Violet Black Star Promos and basic Energy in the Brilliant Stars design. Its foil cards are cosmos holo, except Pokémon V, VMAX, VSTAR, ex and Radiant Pokémon, which keep their usual foil.
